scope: Curated open-weight AI models with obtainable trained weights and sufficient first-party evidence for model identity, license/terms, deployment and provider-origin metadata.

status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: Confirmed by a current primary source governing the exact fact.
status_vocabulary.DOCUMENTED: Officially stated but may describe a broader family or implementation context.
status_vocabulary.NOT_CONFIRMED: No sufficiently reliable current source found; no guess is substituted.
status_vocabulary.EDITORIAL_CLASSIFICATION: OpenWeightModels comparison label derived from documented facts and clearly distinguished from publisher wording.
status_vocabulary.SOURCE_VERIFIED: Current model identity, core specifications, license and deployment facts verified from primary publisher sources; not yet a full Gold-standard review.

benchmark_policy: No synthetic overall score; retain evaluator, checkpoint, metric and conditions where available.
hardware_policy: Hardware classes use total checkpoint scale and documented deployment paths; active MoE parameter counts are not treated as storage footprint. Exact requirements remain checkpoint/runtime/context/precision dependent.
legal_note: Technical comparison only; not legal advice.
eu_deployment_policy: Provider origin does not determine data residency. EU/EEA self-hosting is a technical deployment option, not a GDPR or AI Act compliance badge; inference, RAG, embeddings, logs, telemetry, backups and subprocessors must be assessed separately.
